# M3-15: Import outcomes and timer

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-15`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-15`
- Depends on: M3-14b (and `import_state` from M3-1c)
- Touches (exclusive while running): cmd/, status/
- Plan refs: STATE M2-acceptance lows, R11a, N2
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
A failing bank import shows up in Slack, and a deploy no longer pushes the next import out by a full `IMPORT_INTERVAL`.

## Scope
- The import job records each outcome in `import_state`.
- The status message gains a line with the last import time and result. A failure shows redacted text; Slack failures stay log-only.
- At start, schedule the first import at `last_attempt_at + IMPORT_INTERVAL` (immediately if overdue), then every interval. With no prior state, keep today's behaviour. The attempt time counts, so a crash loop can't hammer import.
- Add the classifier mode and any `auto` downgrade warning to the status message, if M3-14b left it out.

## Out of scope
- Making import failures affect `/healthz`. Changing `IMPORT_INTERVAL`.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: success and failure are persisted; failure text is redacted.
- [ ] Test: status renders a failed import, and "none yet" with no state.
- [ ] Scheduler tests with the injectable ticker and clock: restart mid-interval fires at the remaining delay; overdue fires promptly; repeated restarts don't import more than once per interval.
- [ ] Test: import disabled does nothing.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
